en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘An example of Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> is a example of the Companions of the Cave (As’haab Al-Kahf). They were secretive of the Eman and they manifested the polytheism, so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gave them the Recompense twice’.
en.sarwar: 28. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “
The case of abu Talib islike the case of the people of the cave who hid their faith and expressed polytheism. Allah gave them twice as much reward.”
